entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana with VeloFit. How can I assist you today?
Hi Diana. I'm calling about a VeloBand Cadence Sensor I purchased. I need to make a return, but I'm worried I might be outside the return window due to some unforeseen circumstances.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF-9901-BETA. My name is Alex Chen.

Thank you, Alex. I see the order here. It was delivered on December 15th, so about 39 days ago. To make sure I'm helping correctly, what specifically is the issue with the sensor? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

It's really just a preference. It works as advertised, but it's not what I was looking for. The reason I'm calling so late is that we had a major family emergency. My sister's military deployment was cut short and she had to be flown back for an unexpected surgery. I've been spending all my time at the hospital with her since it happened.

Oh my, I'm so very sorry to hear that. That sounds incredibly stressful. I hope she's on the mend now. Please don't worry about the timing; family comes first. Let me just double-check our return policy for you.
Okay, I've just confirmed in our system. Our standard return policy allows for returns up to 10 days from the date of delivery. So, you are unfortunately outside the timeframe.
Really? 10 days? That's a huge relief. I was preparing to negotiate for some store credit or something. Thank you, that makes things much simpler.

It's absolutely no problem, and I'm happy to help. I also see on your account that you're a VIP member. I've gone ahead and processed the full refund for you, and as a courtesy, I've waived the return shipping fee. I'm emailing you the pre-paid label right now.
Wow, that's incredibly helpful. You've made this entire process painless, Diana. I really appreciate it.
You are very welcome, Alex. Is there anything else I can do for you today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again.
My pleasure. Thank you for being a loyal VeloFit customer, and please send our best wishes to your sister for a speedy recovery. Have a good day.
